comment: MapLibre style for the pit wall's Live GPS Map: satellite imagery.
Served by Streamlit itself from Pit_Dashboard/static/ (which needs
server.enableStaticServing = true in .streamlit/config.toml), so the pit
depends on no third-party style host. Only the imagery tiles come from
outside, and no API key is involved anywhere.
Why a file at all: Streamlit's deck.gl component calls .indexOf() on
mapStyle, so it must be a string URL - passing the same document inline
as a dict throws 'e.mapStyle?.indexOf is not a function'.
Raster-only on purpose: no glyphs and no sprite, because nothing here
draws text or icons. Adding a labels layer later would need both.
